description: Would a browser on this origin be allowed to read this URL? Verdict allowed | blocked | unknown, the reason, and the header to add. Only GET and HEAD are really sent: other methods measure the preflight alone. To audit many origins use cors_test.

origin.description: Origin of the calling page (default: https://yourdomain.com)

request_headers.description: Headers the page sets, e.g. ["Authorization", "Content-Type: application/json"]. Names only are sent.

url.description: Full URL to test, e.g. https://api.example.com/resource

name: cors_checker
